items.headline: Nolan's 'The Odyssey' storms in — his biggest opening ever, in the biggest box-office weekend in history
items.body: Christopher Nolan's mythic epic 'The Odyssey' — Matt Damon as Odysseus, with Tom Holland, Zendaya, Anne Hathaway and Robert Pattinson — opened to about $124M domestic and $264M worldwide, the biggest global launch of Nolan's career. Paired with Spider-Man's monster debut, it powered the largest box-office weekend ever, roughly $434M in North America.
items.say: You see the box office? Nolan's 'Odyssey' and the new Spider-Man made it the biggest movie weekend in history. Have you gotten out to either yet?

items.headline: Richarlison's 92nd-minute winner sinks Chelsea — 10-man Spurs steal the Sydney Super Cup
items.body: In the first Chelsea–Spurs meeting outside the UK in 117 years, Tottenham won a wild one 2-1 in front of 80,363 in Sydney. Sandro Tonali struck early, Estêvão levelled two minutes later, and even after Kevin Danso's red card the 10-man Spurs nicked it when Richarlison pounced in stoppage time — De Zerbi's side are now four-for-four this preseason.
items.say: Chelsea and Tottenham played this preseason friendly in Sydney and Spurs won it with a last-second goal — with only ten men. Real football's nearly back. Who do you follow over there?

items.headline: Deadline day is here — the deals are flying before 6pm ET
items.body: Baseball's trade deadline slams shut at 6pm ET tonight, and after the Dodgers already landed Tarik Skubal, the final-day dominoes are tumbling fast: the Phillies grabbed Luis Arraez from the Giants, the White Sox flipped for Mariners ace Luis Castillo, and the Rays pried Freddy Peralta from the Mets. Buckle up — it usually gets nuttiest right at the buzzer.
items.say: It's MLB trade deadline day — deals closing at 6 tonight. Arraez to the Phillies, Castillo to the White Sox… it's been chaos. You following any of it?

items.headline: Counter-Strike has a new champ — MOUZ topple Team Spirit in Malta
items.body: The BLAST Bounty Summer finals wrapped in Malta with MOUZ beating world No. 1-ish Team Spirit 3-1 in the grand final (Dust2, Mirage, then Nuke to close it out). Israeli star Lotan 'Spinx' Giladi was unplayable — a 1.54 rating across the series and his first career HLTV MVP — as MOUZ banked the $266K top prize.
items.say: MOUZ just won the big Counter-Strike final in Malta over Spirit, and their guy Spinx was ridiculous — first MVP of his career. You keep up with CS at all?

items.headline: The Shield's final chapter — Roman Reigns downs Seth Rollins to close out SummerSlam
items.body: SummerSlam's second night ended with an instant match-of-the-year candidate: Roman Reigns hit Seth Rollins with three straight spears to retain the World Heavyweight Title — his first clean singles win over Rollins — before the two shared a fist bump to put a bow on The Shield's saga. Kevin Owens also returned to win a Fatal 4-Way No. 1 contender's match.
items.say: SummerSlam wrapped last night — Roman Reigns and Seth Rollins had this epic main event that basically closed the book on The Shield. Even casually, it's a fun spectacle. You ever watch WWE?

items.headline: A first major in a playoff — Shiho Kuwaki wins the AIG Women's Open
items.body: The year's final women's major had a nail-biter of a finish at Royal Lytham: Japan's Shiho Kuwaki beat Esther Henseleit on the second playoff hole for her first major title. Henseleit had drained a 40-foot birdie on the 72nd hole just to force extra holes, then found a gorse bush off the tee — and Kuwaki's cool par sealed a record $1.5M payday.
items.say: There was a great golf finish — the Women's Open went to a playoff and Shiho Kuwaki won her first major. The other player holed a 40-footer just to force it. Wild stuff. You watch any golf?

items.headline: Star Wars goes full anime — 'The Ninth Jedi' lands Wednesday
items.body: For the sci-fi crowd, 'Star Wars: Visions Presents — The Ninth Jedi' premieres Wednesday on Disney+ and Hulu. It's an eight-episode anime series — the first longer-form spin-off from the beloved 'Visions' anthology — following young Jedi Lah Kara on a quest to save her father in a galaxy where the Jedi have all but vanished. The trailer looks genuinely gorgeous.
items.say: There's a new Star Wars anime series dropping Wednesday — 'The Ninth Jedi.' Even people who aren't huge Star Wars fans are into these animated ones. You seen the trailer?

items.headline: Lollapalooza wraps — and the surprise cameos stole the weekend
items.body: Chicago's four-day blowout closed out Sunday, and the talkers were the unannounced guests: Olivia Rodrigo popped up during Smashing Pumpkins' set, Charli xcx joined Lorde, and Tate McRae capped the whole thing as Sunday's headliner — laying in a pool of 'liquid gold' mid-set and sending fans into a frenzy over what looks like a new album era.
items.say: Lollapalooza just wrapped and the surprise guests were nuts — Olivia Rodrigo jumped out with Smashing Pumpkins. The clips are everywhere. You ever done a festival like that?

items.headline: The US Open tune-up is on — and a 601st-ranked Canadian pulled off a stunner
items.body: The National Bank Open — a Masters 1000 for the men in Montreal and a WTA 1000 for the women in Toronto — is underway as the marquee hardcourt runway to the US Open. The early highlight: 21-year-old hometown wild card Duncan Chan, ranked No. 601, upset the No. 5 seed to reach his first ATP main draw. Big names like Fritz, Zverev, Shelton and Osaka are all in.
items.say: The big Canadian tennis tournament's on — last real tune-up before the US Open. Some 601st-ranked local kid already knocked off a top seed. Good stuff to throw on. You watch any tennis?
